content:
*Inside The Vault*

***Fallout Worlds*** is the ninth major update for *Fallout 76*. It features changes to private worlds, as well as an expansion to Daily Ops. It was preceded by *Steel Reign* and was followed by *Night of the Moth*.

## Features[]

- Daily Ops Expansion II
- Fallout Worlds: Private World customization
- Nuclear Winter mode removed
- Vault 51 explorable in Adventure mode.
- Season 6: *The Unstoppables vs The Diabolicals*

### Plans[]

Plans for former *Nuclear Winter* overseer rank rewards are not player tradable and those that are already known by the player are not obtainable.

### Nuclear Winter Rewards[]

Previously, many of these items were unlocked at various overseer ranks in *Nuclear Winter*. They are now distributed in end-game event reward and vendor lists, while the other remaining rewards are currently still unobtainable for players that did not previously earn them in *Nuclear Winter*. If the player previously unlocked an item below in *Nuclear Winter*, the plan will not drop from its associated event nor be visible in a vendor. Plans are learned per-character and no longer unlock a reward account-wide, as was the case in *Nuclear Winter*. Despite plans being obtainable in game, the crafted objects are still tagged as Atomic Shop items and are not player tradable or droppable.

A set of framed and unframed pennants were also granted to anyone that completed at least one match of Nuclear Winter before *Fallout Worlds* release. [1]
